shadows.name: toggle-depth
shadows.purpose: Soft depth beneath the main round switch.

motion.name: toggle-transition
motion.purpose: Toggle background, text, ring, and press transform.

motion.name: switch-transition
motion.purpose: Switch knob translation; track uses .2s default ease.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Applied to every element and after pseudo-element for prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

components.name: Main toggle
components.description: Off state of the central last-game action.
components.css: .ds-toggle{width:228px;height:228px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:#283335;color:#c4d1ce;box-shadow:0 12px 28px #00000030;font-family:'Malgun Gothic','Apple SD Gothic Neo','Segoe UI',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background .22s ease-out,color .22s ease-out,transform .22s ease-out}.ds-title{font-size:64px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1.2}.ds-caption{font-size:12px;margin-top:6px}.ds-toggle:hover:not(:disabled){background:#334345}.ds-toggle:active:not(:disabled){transform:scale(.97)}.ds-toggle:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--mint,#8be5bc);outline-offset:5px}.ds-toggle:disabled{cursor:default}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-toggle{transition:none}}

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Countdown cancellation and neutral dialog choice.
components.css: .ds-secondary{padding:11px 14px;border-radius:8px;font:12px 'Malgun Gothic','Apple SD Gothic Neo','Segoe UI',sans-serif;border:1px solid #667471;background:transparent;color:var(--text,#f0f5f3);white-space:nowrap;min-height:40px;cursor:pointer}.ds-secondary:hover{background:#ffffff12}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--mint,#8be5bc);outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Warning button
components.description: Confirms the PC shutdown option inside its explanation dialog.
components.css: .ds-warning{padding:11px 14px;border-radius:8px;font:700 12px 'Malgun Gothic','Apple SD Gothic Neo','Segoe UI',sans-serif;border:1px solid var(--orange,#ffb080);background:var(--orange,#ffb080);color:#412715;white-space:nowrap;min-height:40px;cursor:pointer}.ds-warning:hover{background:#ffc29e}.ds-warning:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--mint,#8be5bc);outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Option switch
components.description: Native checkbox semantics and a sliding mint state indicator.
components.css: .ds-option{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;padding:17px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#344143);color:var(--text,#f0f5f3);font:14px 'Malgun Gothic','Apple SD Gothic Neo','Segoe UI',sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-option>span:first-child{flex:1}.ds-option input{position:absolute;right:0;width:44px;height:44px;opacity:0;margin:0;cursor:pointer}.ds-switch{width:38px;height:22px;background:#4a5859;border-radius:20px;pointer-events:none;transition:background .2s}.ds-switch:after{content:'';display:block;width:16px;height:16px;background:#e1e8e6;border-radius:50%;margin:3px;transition:transform .2s ease-out}.ds-option input:checked+.ds-switch{background:var(--mint,#8be5bc)}.ds-option input:checked+.ds-switch:after{transform:translateX(16px);background:#17432f}.ds-option input:focus-visible+.ds-switch{outline:3px solid var(--mint,#8be5bc);outline-offset:5px}.ds-option:has(input:disabled),.ds-option input:disabled{cursor:default}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-switch,.ds-switch:after{transition:none}}

components.name: Countdown
components.description: Inline shutdown timer with cancellation in the same surface.
components.html:
30초 후 PC 종료

저장하지 않은 작업을 확인해 주세요.
components.css: .ds-countdown{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:16px;background:#34271f;border-radius:12px;color:var(--orange,#ffb080);font-family:'Malgun Gothic','Apple SD Gothic Neo','Segoe UI',sans-serif}.ds-countdown strong{font-size:16px}.ds-seconds{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-countdown p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;margin:6px 0 0}.ds-cancel{padding:11px 14px;border-radius:8px;font:12px 'Malgun Gothic','Apple SD Gothic Neo','Segoe UI',sans-serif;border:1px solid #667471;background:transparent;color:var(--text,#f0f5f3);white-space:nowrap;min-height:40px;cursor:pointer}.ds-cancel:hover{background:#ffffff12}.ds-cancel:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--mint,#8be5bc);outline-offset:5px}@media(max-width:440px){.ds-countdown{padding:12px}.ds-countdown strong{font-size:15px}}

narrative.overview: The user's selected dark gaming style uses graphite surfaces, a large circular switch, mint activation, and orange PC shutdown. The shared interface lives in packages/desktop/src/ui. The monorepo adds macOS and Windows entry points without changing the visual direction. The macOS shutdown dialog explains administrator authorization. Real-game detection and shutdown still require verification on both operating systems.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite surfaces with functional mint and orange states.
Korean system typography and inline line icons.
Short status explanations beside explicit cancellation controls.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Keep mint and orange tied to the implemented activation and shutdown meanings; accompany both with text.

dos: Do preserve the Korean name and dominant round toggle.
Do show state and disabled explanations in readable Korean text.
Do retain keyboard focus and accessible switch/button semantics.
Do keep cancellation visible and focusable during the countdown.
donts: Don't replace the user-selected dark gaming direction with the random seed.
Don't use orange for ordinary activation without PC shutdown context.
Don't treat simulation screenshots as Windows functional verification.
